rationale: Recent output-head and transplant detours moved away from the current recurrent-tail QK best without improving the final exact metric. This run keeps the best architecture and quantization path intact, but reallocates the 600-second budget toward more optimizer updates: the default train batch drops from 6144 to 5120 while staying on the fast single-microbatch path, validation batch size rises to 12288 so the exact endgame is cheaper, train logging relaxes to every 100 steps, and the fixed final-eval reserve trims from 72s to 68s. The hypothesis is that this search is now step-limited rather than capacity-limited on the Mac mini, so more five-sequence updates plus a leaner eval budget have a better chance than another tiny quantization replay.
title: Five-Sequence Updates With Larger Eval Batch
